code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a solid nonzero separator, then intersect the two adjoining panels.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
            n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
            return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(top[i], bottom[i])] for i in range(n)]
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] and grid[0][c] != 0 for r in range(h)):
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
            n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
            return [[2 if left[r][j] != 0 and right[r][j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''; open(p,'w').write(code); print(code)
